narrative.details:
Light! Don't bring things like that into the Lodge... it's unsanitary, unspeakable, un... un... unsanitary!

Just get it out of here, will you? No one wants to see your bloody little trophy, really!
narrative.objectives: Bring Ol' Sooty's head to Vyrin Swiftwind at the Farstrider Lodge.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thanks for helping me out with my little plan, adventurer. I've been itching for months to get back at that snooty, stuck-up boy, and I'd say we did a pretty good job! Here, have this, you've earned it.
narrative.requestItemsText: Great job, adventurer! We really showed him! Here, give me the head and I'll take care of it.
